# synology_share_permission (Resource)

One principal's explicit shared-folder permission. Inherit (no explicit grant or deny) is distinct from deny. Other principals and descendant file ACLs remain outside this resource's ownership. Import using share:local_group:group or share:local_user:user.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access` (String) Explicit permission: inherit, deny, read_only, or read_write. Inherit does not imply the principal can access the folder; effective access also depends on groups and ACLs.
- `principal` (String) Local account or group name.
- `principal_type` (String) local_user or local_group.
- `share` (String) Shared-folder name. Reference synology_shared_folder.name to establish ordering.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Protect permission removal. Disable in a separate apply before revoking access, or stop management with a removed block and destroy=false.
